name: Deformation Texture
definition: A technique to encode a complex deformation function into a 3D texture by storing samples of the inverse deformation function evaluated on a regular 3D grid, allowing efficient evaluation in fragment shaders via trilinear interpolation.
summary: Deformation Texture encodes inverse deformation mappings into a 3D texture to enable real-time evaluation of complex deformations, unlike direct shader methods suited only for simple bends.
